g.text: The nine-method layout mirrors the source figure; GPFA controls are replaced by independently retrained M1, M2 and S1 LFADS factors.

text.style: font-size: 6.1px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6675

g.text: Boxes are 48 trial-wise values (5th-95th percentile whiskers). Pairwise two-sided Wilcoxon tests compare LDR with each control within region; Holm-adjusted values are stored in the source metrics. Trials are not animals.
